name: CMU 07_05 slow walk
units: source CMU units; scale using restLegLengths
conversion: Canonical frame is source rotated by pi around Y. XZ root origin removed. Y remains absolute. First source frame is converter-added T pose and excluded from animation. No smoothing or timing warp applied.

recommendedCycle.source: Low horizontal-speed support windows measured at the original 120 Hz. These are heuristic stable-contact times, not first heel-impact annotations.

contactWindows.method: Minimum ankle/toe XZ speed, centered over four source intervals; gaps up to 90 ms merged. No global foot-Y cutoff because source ground height drifts. Source pose curves are unchanged.
